articles.title: Freedom Mobile to upgrade all plans to Canada/U.S./Mexico data
articles.text:
Freedom Mobile is giving all monthly mobile data plans access to Canada/U.S./Mexico data coverage at no extra cost.
In an announcement sent to MobileSyrup on Nov. 5, the carrier said it would update eligible customers’ data plans starting on Dec. 8.
“There are no changes to customers’ monthly price or recurring data allotment. Instead, customers will benefit from a simpler experience, using their included data seamlessly across Canada, the United States and Mexico without daily roaming fees or the need to swap SIM cards while travelling,” Freedom said.
Notably, Freedom has offered plans with Canada/U.S./Mexico data for a while now, as well as other roaming benefits like Roam Beyond data and unlimited talk and text in over 120 global destinations.
However, for customers on older Freedom plans that might not have the Canada/U.S./Mexico coverage, this is a major win. It also aligns with some of Freedom’s other benefits, like the carrier’s ‘Price Freeze Promise,” which pledges not to increase customers’ wireless rates as long as they keep their plan.
This comes after Freedom said it was “gearing up to switch on its wireless network in Manitoba” last month as it continues a push to expand its Canadian network.

articles.title: Most companies don't think they could leave their main cloud provider quickly should the worst happen
articles.text:
Most companies don't think they could leave their main cloud provider quickly should the worst happen
Vendor lock-in is about much more than data
- Businesses are starting to recognize that they're locked into vendors from all angles
- AI could add yet another element to keep customers locked into providers
- Four in five have already taken action to move, many would even pay a premium
Nine in 10 (89%) businesses admit they couldn't migrate business-critical workloads away from their primary cloud provider within three weeks if it came to it evidencing widespread vendor lock-in challenges.
New Leaseweb research found more than half (55%) said it would take longer than three months, not weeks – or that it wouldn't even be possible.
But this reality contrasts with a false perception of control – three in four (76%) of the 800 surveyed C-suite leaders feel they have 'complete' or 'high' control over their ability to move data to another provider.
Cloud lock-in is more widespread than businesses perceive
One of the biggest challenges cited in the Leaseweb report centers around applications built to a particular provider's infrastructure – while the customer may retain control over their data, picking up and moving that application to another cloud provider isn't so simple.
But despite best efforts to level the playing field, improve interoperability and eliminate vendor lock-in, many European countries are still struggling on this front. The Netherlands reported the longest average migration time, at 4.7 months.
Looking ahead, four in five (79%) business leaders expect things to get worse through AI adoption, because buying into specific AI tools would increase their dependence on a small number of providers.
Cloud infrastructure is undergoing a global change
Leaseweb also noted that geopolitical tensions are continuing to reshape the cloud landscape, with four in five (78%) businesses already having taken action to reduce their reliance on a provider.
Sign up to the TechRadar Pro newsletter to get all the top news, opinion, features and guidance your business needs to succeed!
Interestingly, while the EU leads many discussions around digital sovereignty, it was the US that saw the highest proportion (91%) of businesses taking action.
Crucially, businesses are clearly willing to pay a premium to have greater control over their infrastructure, with the average business prepared to pay 16% more.
Still, Leaseweb is warning businesses that they have less control than they think they have. "With AI expected to tie businesses even more closely to a small number of providers, leaders need to understand and act on those dependencies now, not when a pricing change or geopolitical shift forces their hand," co-CEO Lex Boost wrote.

articles.title: UPERFECT GR14BU portable monitor review: A 120 Hz 3K OLED touch display at a killer price
articles.text:
Tom's Hardware Verdict
Although it has some flaws, the GR14BU excels in value pricing, features, and performance.
Reasons to buy
- + Bright, colorful display
- + 3K resolution and touch support
- + 120 Hz panel
- + Value pricing
Reasons to avoid
- - Kickstand and overall design don’t support portrait mode
- - Cheap OSD buttons
Why you can trust Tom's Hardware
Our expert reviewers spend hours testing and comparing products and services so you can choose the best for you. Find out more about how we test.
As the portable monitor category matures, a number of new players have entered the market to claim their share of the pie. One company that we haven’t had a chance to sample yet is UPERFECT. But the company is coming out of the gate swinging with the first review sample that it sent our way: the GR14BU.
As its name suggests, the GR14BU is a 14-inch portable monitor, but it doesn’t have a run-of-the-mill 60 Hz 1080p IPS panel like you’ll find on most of the best portable monitors in this segment. Instead, it features an OLED panel with a dense 2880 × 1800 (3K) resolution and a 120 Hz maximum refresh rate. On top of that, the GR14BU also supports touch input in Windows 11.
On paper, it’s a promising product with a street price of under $300. That’s roughly three times the price of a garden-variety 14-inch IPS panels, but is it worth the premium?
Design of the UPERFECT GR14BU
At first glance, the GR14BU impresses with its black aluminum frame that wraps around the 14-inch panel. The sleek design is enhanced by the glossy glass, which is typical for OLED panels.
Things take a downward turn from there, however. While the GR14BU features an integrated kickstand, which is much appreciated on a portable monitor, it’s tiny and is mounted directly in the middle of the back panel of the monitor. Because of this position, the GR14BU can only be used in landscape mode. Even if you could somehow prop the monitor up in portrait mode, this would be hindered by the two USB-C ports and HDMI port on the right side of the monitor, and the five OSD buttons on the left side.
Speaking of the OSD buttons, they feel cheap and wobble around like buttons you might find on a cheap plastic stopwatch you’d find at Dollar Tree. They’re shockingly bad for a device with a $399 MSRP. The five buttons are: Power, OSD, Up, Down, and Back.
UPERFECT included a plethora of cables and adapters in the box, which should satisfy all your connectivity needs. Our review unit included two USB-C-to-USB-C cables, one micro-HDMI to HDMI cable, two 180-degree USB-C to USB-C adapters, one 180-degree micro-HDMI to HDMI adapter, and one USB-C wall adapter.

View Original
View Original
View Original
One thing to note as we discuss cables and adapters is that when connecting the GR14BU to my test system using a single USB-C to USB-C cable, the monitor was locked at 20 percent brightness and would not go any higher. However, when using the second USB-C to USB-C adapter connected to the USB-C wall adapter, the GR14BU would automatically boost brightness to its maximum level.
UPERFECT GR14BU Specifications
| Panel Type / Backlight | OLED | 
| Screen Size / Aspect Ratio | 14 inches / 16:10 | 
| Max Resolution & Refresh Rate | 2880 x 1600 @ 120 Hz | 
| Response Time | 1 ms (GtG) | 
| Typical Brightness | 500 nits | 
| Contrast Ratio Typical | 100,000:1 | 
| Ports | 2x USB-C (DisplayPort Alt Mode), 1x micro-HDMI | 
| Speakers | 2 x 1-watt | 
| Touch Support | Yes | 
| Dimensions | 12.2 x 8.5 x 0.28 inches | 
| Weight | 1.3 pounds | 
| Warranty | 1 year | 
OSD on the UPERFECT GR14BU
The OSD on the GR14BU is no-frills, offering just the basic controls that you’d expect to find on a portable monitor. Without even accessing the main OSD, pressing the Up button brings up the volume controls, with a subsequent press of the Up button raising the volume, while pressing the Down button lowers the volume. Likewise, pressing the Down button separately invokes the Brightness menu.
Pressing the dedicated OSD button brings up the full menu, where you can access picture and color settings. Pressing the Up and Down buttons navigates you through the OSD; pressing the OSD button again executes a menu item, while the Back button takes you back one level in the OSD.
Display Performance on the UPERFECT GR14BU
The GR14BU features a 14-inch display with a dense-for-its-size 2880 x 1600 resolution, in a 16:10 aspect ratio. That pixel-dense panel is backed by a 120 Hz refresh rate, which is twice that of most portable monitors, along with multi-touch support in Windows 11.
UPERFECT claims that the GR14BU has a maximum brightness of 500 nits, but we measured a maximum of 368.6 nits when plugged in at 100 percent. While well short of the manufacturer’s claim, this is clsoe to peers like the Asus ZenScreen OLED MQ16AH (369.4 nits) and ViewSonic ColorPro VP16-OLED (369.8 nits).
Our instrumented tests also showed similar color performance to the Asus and ViewSonic. The GR14BU measured 132.2 percent coverage of the DCI-P3 color space, while sRGB coverage came in at 186.6 percent.
In real-world scenarios, I found the panel to be sufficiently bright in my well-lit home office, and even enough to overcome most reflections when sitting outside in overcast conditions. Colors looked vibrant, with especially punchy reds and greens while looking at nature footage on YouTube. As with all OLED monitors, black levels were impeccable, which I particularly took note of while watching the latest teaser trailers for Avengers: Doomsday.
For my usual productivity tasks, I was really disappointed that I couldn’t use the GR14BU in portrait mode, which is probably the biggest miss for me. I like having that versatility to switch between portrait and landscape modes at will.
I also tested out the 120 Hz refresh rate at native resolution for gaming. I played Battlefield 6 with the GR14BU hooked up to my desktop computer via HDMI and had no trouble until there was heavy action on the screen. It was then that frame rates momentarily dipped into the 90 fps range, and I noticed a bit of screen tearing. The GR14BU doesn’t support any kind of Adaptive-Sync technology, like FreeSync or G-Sync.
UPERFECT includes a pair of tinny speakers integrated into the GR14BU. There is quite a bit of audio distortion once you get past 75 percent, but if you keep the volume at a moderate level, the quality is passable. There’s no bass, and music sounds flat (I tried various genres, ranging from Jay-Z to Susanne Sundfør to Jai Wolf). You’re better off relying on your laptop’s built-in speakers than relying on the pair included on the GR14BU.
Bottom Line
I came in expecting a lot from the UPERFECT GR14BU, given its specs. However, there are plenty of caveats. The GR14BU has a bright and colorful 3K OLED panel, along with a 120 Hz refresh rate. It even includes an integrated kickstand and internal speakers.
However, the kickstand doesn’t allow the monitor to be used in portrait mode, and the 120 Hz maximum refresh rate doesn’t have the backing of Adaptive-Sync. There are also some quality lapses, like the woefully cheap OSD buttons.
However, much of this can be overlooked considering the price. The GR14BU can be had right now for $299 from Amazon, making it an incredible value given the specs. For comparison, we recently reviewed the Asus ZenScreen OLED (MQ16FC), which has a 16.1-inch 1200p OLED non-touch display with a 60 Hz refresh rate. The GR14BU outclasses the MQ16FC in color performance, brightness, and specs while only commanding a $30 premium and including touch. That’s an impressive feat, despite its design and build deficiencies.
Brandon Hill is a senior editor at Tom's Hardware. He has written about PC and Mac tech since the late 1990s with bylines at AnandTech, DailyTech, and Hot Hardware. When he is not consuming copious amounts of tech news, he can be found enjoying the NC mountains or the beach with his wife and two sons.

articles.title: Spacetech startup Cosmoserve raises $6M in seed round
articles.text:
Spacetech startup Cosmoserve raises $6M in seed round
Cosmoserve also opened a facility in Hyderabad which will be utilised for satellite servicing and space debris recovery.
Cosmoserve Space, a Hyderabad-based spacetech startup, has raised $6 million in a seed round of funding from Rebright Partners of Japan, Aranya Holdings, and Naandi Ventures.
The round also saw participation from existing investors AUM Ventures and Shakti VC. This funding round has seen Cosmoserve raising over $9 million.
Cosmoserve also inaugurated Base 1 - a facility to design, build, test and operate systems for satellite servicing and space debris recovery. A statement said, this facility will have an orbital rendezvous and capture lab to simulate spacecraft capture operations, a space robotics innovation Lab to develop robotic capture systems; a clean room for satellite integration, a mission simulation and control Centre to manage upcoming missions.
“In our first year we have flown our first payload on an Indian rocket, raised our seed round, and today we open a facility where we can design, build, test and fly our missions under one roof. Debris is becoming the limiting factor for every nation's space ambitions, including India's. Base 1 is where we build the capability to keep orbits usable, for Gaganyaan, the Bharatiya Antariksh Station and every satellite that follows,” said Chiranjeevi Phanindra, Founder & CEO of Cosmoserve Space.
Beyond removing space debris, the company said the facility will support satellite servicing, including in-orbit repairs and refuelling. Cosmoserve currently sources close to 60% of its mission components locally. The company aims to develop more critical technologies in-house through Base 1 and strengthen domestic manufacturing capabilities.
According to the spacetech startup, space debris is one of the biggest challenges facing the global space industry. Of the approximately 28,000 satellites in orbit, nearly 10,000 are dead or non-operational.
Beyond these inactive satellites, Earth's orbit is crowded with an estimated 68,000 debris objects. Even fragments can pose serious risks to operational satellites, spacecraft and missions such as the International Space Station (ISS), given the high speeds at which they travel.

articles.title: Celular com a 2ª melhor câmera do mundo chega ao Brasil • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Celular com a 2ª melhor câmera do mundo chega ao Brasil
Motorola Signature 27 tem preço a partir de R$ 10.999, com Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 e memória RAM de 12 GB.
A Motorola lança nesta quinta-feira (05/11) um novo smartphone ultrapremium no Brasil: o Motorola Signature 27 tem preço a partir de R$ 10.999. Ele tem a melhor câmera de smartphone lançado em 2026 e a segunda melhor do mundo. Além disso, é o primeiro aparelho com Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, tela com pico de brilho de 12.000 nits e bateria de 7.000 mAh.
O modelo já está em pré-venda por R$ 10.999, na versão de 256 GB. A configuração de 512 GB era a única do antecessor no lançamento. Agora ela sai por R$ 11.999, ou seja, R$ 3.000 a mais que o Motorola Signature original, que estreou em março por R$ 8.999. Com isso, a fabricante passa dos R$ 10 mil entre os seus celulares de formato tradicional. Só os dobráveis custam mais: o Razr 70 Ultra sai por R$ 12.999 e o Razr Fold, por R$ 15.999.
A chefe de marketing do laboratório DXO Mark, especializado em testes de fotografia, revelou que o Signature 27 conquistou o segundo lugar entre as melhores câmeras do planeta neste ano. Além disso, traz o melhor sistema de câmera lançado em 2026. De acordo com Aurélie Singer, o produto traz uma série de avanços, com destaque para a fidelidade do tom de pele registrado pelo smartphone.
Aurélie enfatizou que o produto tem bom desempenho tanto em fotos quanto em vídeos, e em todos os sensores. O Signature 27 obteve 173 pontos no DXOMARK, atrás apenas do Huawei Pura 80 Ultra (175 pontos), lançado em 2025. Logo atrás da Motorola estão: iPhone 18 Pro (172), Vivo/Jovi X300 Pro (171), Oppo Find X9 Ultra 170) e Vivo/Jovi X300 Ultra (170).
A teleobjetiva periscópica tem 200 MP, zoom óptico de 3x e zoom híbrido de até 100x. Já a câmera principal usa o sensor Sony LYTIA L910, de 50 MP. Ela traz a tecnologia LOFIC, que amplia a captura de informação em cenas com grande diferença de luz, como shows e paisagens urbanas à noite.
Completam o conjunto uma ultrawide de 50 MP com modo macro e uma câmera frontal de 50 MP. O celular grava vídeos em até 8K com Dolby Vision. A empresa promete fotos e os vídeos com Ultra HDR no Instagram, graças a uma parceria com a Meta.
A Motorola diz que o aparelho é o primeiro do mundo com um Action Sensor dedicado. Trata-se de um sensor de visão baseado em eventos (EVS, na sigla em inglês), criado pela Sony, que registra o movimento de forma independente das câmeras. Segundo a fabricante, o sensor ajuda a congelar cenas em alta velocidade no modo Action Shot.
O Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 foi anunciado pela Qualcomm em setembro. Segundo a Motorola, os ganhos em relação ao Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 são de até 37% na eficiência energética da CPU, até 35% no desempenho da NPU e até 44% no desempenho da GPU. O antecessor usava o Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, uma versão menos potente.
O SoC funciona em conjunto com a memória RAM LPDDR5 de 12 GB.
Para controlar o aquecimento, o sistema ArcticMesh usa gel térmico com microdiamantes e uma câmara de vapor 40% maior que a do modelo anterior.
A tela de 6,8 polegadas usa a tecnologia Extreme AMOLED Duo, que empilha dois painéis AMOLED para aumentar o brilho e reduzir o consumo. O pico é de 12.000 nits, o maior do mercado segundo a fabricante, considerando os celulares lançados até outubro. A Motorola afirma que o painel consome até 34% menos energia e dura até 121% mais do que a tela AMOLED do Signature anterior.
A bateria passa de 5.200 mAh para 7.000 mAh, com tecnologia de silício-carbono, e promete até 62 horas de uso misto. O carregamento com fio é de 90 W, com carregador incluso na caixa. O sem fio chega a 50 W, mas exige um carregador vendido à parte. A bateria maior tem um custo: o Signature 27 tem 7,99 mm de espessura e pesa 227 g. O antecessor, que tinha a espessura como um dos destaques, media cerca de 7 mm e pesava 186 g.
Na lista de itens que reforçam o posicionamento ultrapremium estão o áudio assinado pela Bang & Olufsen; as certificações IP68, IP69 e IP69K contra água e poeira; o padrão militar MIL-STD-810H; e o vidro Gorilla Glass Ceramic 3.
O aparelho terá sete atualizações do Android e sete anos de atualizações de segurança. Na parte de IA, o Gemini Intelligence promete executar tarefas com várias etapas em diferentes aplicativos, e a Motorola Qira integra celulares e computadores da Motorola e da Lenovo.
O modelo também será o primeiro da Motorola compatível com o GrapheneOS, sistema operacional de código aberto focado em privacidade. A empresa diz que mais detalhes serão divulgados no futuro.
O Motorola Signature 27 já está em pré-venda no site da Motorola, nas cores Pantone Coal Smoke (cinza-chumbo) e Pantone Capulet Olive (verde). Confira os valores informados pela Motorola:
| Armazenamento | RAM | Preço | 
|---|---|---|
| 256 GB | 12 GB | R$ 10.999 | 
| 512 GB | 12 GB | R$ 11.999 | 
Nas operadoras, quem fez o pré-registro tem um voucher de R$ 1.000. Na Claro, o aparelho sai a partir de R$ 7.799 em 21x sem juros, no plano Multi 200GB. Na Vivo, sai a partir de R$ 7.199, no plano Vivo Total Família 4/5. No varejo, a Amazon, Magalu, Mercado Livre, Inter Shop e Bradesco Shop oferecem parcelamento em até 21x.
A fabricante também oferece um pacote com a capa magnética Moto Snap Case por R$ 99 e o relógio Moto Watch Ultra por R$ 2.899.

articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Shipments Fall 41%, But Its Software Sales Climb 26%
articles.text:
Thursday, November 5th 2026
Nintendo Switch 2 Shipments Fall 41%, But Its Software Sales Climb 26%
Nintendo released its Q3 earnings data, revealing updated information on console shipments, including the original Switch and the updated Switch 2 console. During the fiscal second quarter, which Nintendo defines as the period between July and September instead of the traditional Q3, the company shipped 2.67 million Nintendo Switch 2 consoles. This marks a decrease of 41% from 4.54 million units a year earlier and a 30% decline from 3.82 million units in the April-June quarter. The original Switch shipped 610,000 units, down 33% year-on-year. While hardware sales have decreased, the company is relying on its software unit sales to compensate.
Switch 2 software sales rose 26% to 15.03 million units, led by new releases like Splatoon Raiders, which achieved 2.42 million sales, and Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, with 1.34 million sales. The original Switch software reached 31.92 million units, bolstered by Rhythm Heaven Groove, which sold 2.89 million units. Digital sales grew 37% year-on-year to approximately $734 million (116.9 billion yen), making up 59.8% of software sales. Overall, quarterly revenue was about $2.81 billion (448.2 billion yen), and net profit fell 29% to approximately $461 million (73.5 billion yen), both below analyst expectations. Nintendo maintained its full-year forecast of 16.5 million Switch 2 units and about $1.95 billion (310 billion yen) in net profit.Declining hardware sales are attributed to supply chain problems, which have led Nintendo to increase pricing on its consoles a few times in the past. Sourcing memory and storage became notoriously difficult, so the company resorted to price hikes, which might not be entirely over as memory supply continues to be a problem. However, strong software sales are helping the company stay profitable despite the challenges in hardware supply.

articles.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Meta president Dina Powell McCormick said that the Democratic wins in the midterm elections are going to make it a lot harder for companies to build data centers, adding that the industry has “not done as good a job as we needed to explain the benefits of these investments.”
Speaking at the WSJ Tech conference on Wednesday, the Meta exec pointed out that the backlash against data centers — which was very much on the ballot during this election season — was also tied to people’s feelings about AI technology overall.
“The visible sort of manifestation of AI is a data center, and it’s something that people can say, ‘I don’t want this in my community,’” she explained. “I think there’s an underlying bigger issue, which is how people feel about AI in general.”
Meta believes it could turn around the negative consumer sentiment around AI if it’s able to demonstrate the value, not only of the data centers coming to local communities, but also in the technology itself.
“The stakes of who builds the technology that cures cancer, that gives access to education, that is also a very fundamental difference … Mark [Zuckerberg, Meta CEO] is very ‘long human,’ and he’s betting on humans more than machines,” Powell McCormick explained. “And that’s what we mean when we say the future is for everyone. That people should not be left behind. But the way to ensure that is that this technology is democratized, that people have access to it in a very fair and transparent way,” she said.
The exec also touted Meta’s experience in building data centers, saying that the company has been doing so for 20 years, as it takes a lot of compute power to offer the products it does in the social networking space. Today, the company has data centers in 23 states, she said, and five of them, including one in Texas, are planned as projects of 1 gigawatt or more.
But Meta is now worried that it could lose some of its investments after politicians ran on anti-data-center platforms during the midterms.
“I think it’s going to be harder,” Powell McCormick said, describing what the future of building data centers looks like. “It has been hard, I should say, but I also think that it’s becoming clear what models work, and the states want those models that work.”
Specifically, communities only want data centers when it benefits them in some way, she explained, laying out the approach that Meta today uses to close its data center deals in local communities.
Successful projects see Meta paying for its own electricity, directing any tax surpluses as a result of the data centers toward teachers and first responders, keeping the labor force local, and getting bipartisan support for the project, among other things.
Going forward, she expects data center projects to come under more review and be weighed against whether the constituents actually want them.
Meta has pinned its hopes on its AI investments, particularly its consumer AI agent Muse scaling far beyond the 10 million users it has today, to become a business that one day serves billions. But even if that’s not the case, it believes that its investments in data centers will not be for nothing, as the compute itself will be valuable.
“We’re getting calls every day to lease that compute [we’ve built], and so one way or another, we’re seeing a path to monetization,” Powell McCormick said.

articles.title: Multipliés par dix en un an, les vols de câbles sur les bornes électriques risquent de faire grimper le prix de vos recharges
articles.text:
Vols de câbles sur les bornes de recharge : 15 % du réseau touché et un risque de hausse des tarifs pour les conducteurs
Les vols de câbles sur les bornes de recharge explosent en France, avec plus de 1 000 stations dégradées fin octobre 2026.Une situation qui contraint les conducteurs de voitures électriques à toujours prévoir une solution de secours sur la route, tout en faisant peser le risque d’une hausse des tarifs.
Arriver devant une borne avec moins de 10 % de batterie et découvrir une station de recharge totalement hors d’usage devient une mésaventure de plus en plus courante pour les conducteurs de voitures électriques. La faute à des câbles volés pour récupérer et revendre le cuivre qu'ils contiennent. Ce phénomène prend une telle ampleur qu’il inquiète aujourd’hui les opérateurs, les automobilistes et jusqu’aux bancs de l’Assemblée nationale. Le pire serait une répercussion de ces dégradations sur le prix du kWh facturé aux usagers.
Quelques kilos de cuivre dérobés pour des millions d’euros de dégâts, une riposte politique bientôt enclenchée ?
Selon l’association Charge France, les vols de câbles ont été multipliés par dix en un an, touchant un millier de sites fin octobre 2026, soit plus de 15 % des bornes de recharge rapide déployées en France. Il faut dire que le cuivre (revendu aux alentours de 13 € le kilo) peut être récupéré sans risque d’électrocution, étant donné que le courant ne circule dans le câble que lorsqu’une voiture est branchée.
Si le butin ne dépasse pas quelques dizaines d’euros par câble, le préjudice global atteint 14 à 21 millions d’euros, totalisant 637 à 800 plaintes déposées en 2026. Comme les assureurs refuseraient de couvrir ces pertes, les opérateurs pourraient répercuter la facture sur leurs grilles tarifaires. D’autant que les exploitants comme Ionity doivent aussi financer de coûteux systèmes de sécurité pour se protéger, allant des caméras et alarmes aux câbles équipés de traceurs GPS ou d’encre indélébile.
Face à ces dégradations qui peuvent “rendre certaines stations indisponibles pendant plusieurs semaines et compromettre les déplacements des automobilistes”, la députée Olga Givernet (Ensemble pour la République) a interpellé le ministère de l’Intérieur le 3 novembre 2026. Dans sa question écrite au gouvernement, elle juge que “la multiplication de ces vols appelle une réponse publique renforcée” et que les pouvoirs publics “doivent également veiller à la fiabilité de l’accès à la recharge”.
L’élue propose ainsi d’examiner si “les installations les plus stratégiques pourraient bénéficier d’une protection renforcée au titre des dispositifs applicables aux infrastructures critiques”, via une directive européenne de 2022. Une piste soutenue par Charge France, qui rappelle qu’au Portugal, ce statut et une condamnation à neuf ans de prison ont éradiqué le problème, alors que des peines de deux ans ferme viennent d’être prononcées à Toulouse et Troyes.
Une réponse ferme des pouvoirs publics devient urgente, la fiabilité du réseau étant indispensable pour rassurer les automobilistes réfléchissant à sauter le pas en abandonnant leur voiture thermique pour l’électrique.

articles.title: Adif usa maquinistas y trenes comerciales con pasajeros para confirmar ciertos fallos en las vías
articles.text:
Se suponía que las del 29N iban a ser las elecciones de la crisis de la vivienda, el tema que lleva meses encabezando el ranking de principales preocupaciones de los españoles y que, tras un intenso culebrón parlamentario, precipitó el adelanto electoral. Tras la tragedia de Urda ya no está tan claro. La gestión de la infraestructura ferroviaria de alta velocidad (AV) lleva una semana acaparando el debate público. Eso explica que la última exclusiva de ABC haya generado expectación: el diario ha revelado una directriz interna de Adif que anima a utilizar trenes comerciales para certificar incidencias en las vías.
Dicho de otro modo (y de forma resumida), cuando se detecta una pequeña anomalía en la red de AV no se moviliza necesariamente a los técnicos. En ocasiones, antes debe comprobarla el siguiente convoy que circule por la zona.
¿Qué ha pasado? Que Borja Méndez firma hoy una crónica en ABC en la que revela un protocolo de Adif que hasta ahora había pasado inadvertido: la Ficha Específica LAV2 prevé que cuando se detecte una alteración leve en la red de AV deba ser el siguiente maquinista que pase por la zona quien lo confirme.
Es decir, Adif no tiene por qué cortar el tramo de forma automática y alertar a los técnicos de mantenimiento al instante. Antes puede recurrirse a otro convoy comercial (con su personal y pasajeros) a modo de inspector in situ, una especie de ‘banco de pruebas’ que sirve para descartar falsas alarmas.
¿Qué dice exactamente la orden? La directriz de Adif es clara. Cuando un maquinista detecta una anomalía de “repercusión débil” en una vía, el administrador ferroviario no tiene por qué adoptar una respuesta inmediata que pase por suspender el tráfico en el tramo ‘sospechoso’.
El protocolo es otro: se encarga al siguiente maquinista que pase por la zona que esté atento para comprobar si realmente hay un problema o el aviso de su anterior compañero se debió a otras causas, como un fallo en la suspensión del tren.
¿Qué es una “repercusión débil”? Ahí está la clave. La normativa consultada por ABC, de carácter interno, distingue cuatro escenarios distintos, en función de lo que haya percibido el maquinista que advierte de la anomalía. Hay fallos débiles, moderados, fuertes y muy fuertes.
El protocolo en cuestión se centra en los primeros, los débiles: baches, vibraciones fuera de lo común o sacudidas. Cuando el conductor percibe una anomalía así, el Centro de Control de Tráfico avisa al siguiente maquinista que circule por la zona y le pide que esté atento al comportamiento del tren. El objetivo: corroborar que efectivamente pasa algo en la vía.
Adif utiliza trenes con pasajeros para detectar fallos de «repercusión débil» en las vías @Borjamendez https://t.co/Jr3ygkA1vF
— ABC.es (@abc_es) November 5, 2026
¿Y luego, qué? Cuando se alcanza ese ‘doble check’ sobre el terreno, el escenario cambia. Los trenes adaptan su velocidad (hay diferentes escenarios posibles) y una vez confirmada la sospecha se moviliza a los técnicos. La directriz de Adif deja claro que ese paso no es estrictamente necesario “hasta que [la incidencia] sea confirmada por las circulaciones siguientes”. Como recoge Méndez en su crónica, no todos los profesionales comparten esa forma de proceder, que básicamente utiliza trenes comerciales (con pasajeros a bordo) para confirmar anomalías en la infraestructura.
¿Por qué es importante? Aunque 2026 está siendo un año trágico para el ferrocarril, con dos siniestros en menos de 10 meses (Adamuz y Urda) que suman 115 víctimas mortales y decenas de heridos, no abundan los accidentes de esa gravedad en la historia de la AV española. Y eso habla de sus protocolos.
El problema es el enfoque del protocolo analizado por ABC: su idea de fondo es priorizar la agilidad del tráfico ferroviario para evitar incidencias. Y eso es importante si se tiene en cuenta que el gestor debe compaginar dos valores clave: la fluidez operativa y la seguridad del servicio.
¿Qué hacer si un maquinista sospecha haber detectado un fallo menor en la vía? ¿Debe interrumpirse el tráfico, ordenar una limitación temporal de velocidad y asumir retrasos en el servicio, aunque al final se trate de una falsa alarma? La directriz de Adif deja sobre la mesa otra pregunta: ¿Debe esperarse que sean los maquinistas que están conduciendo trenes comerciales quienes se encarguen de detectar anomalías o confirmar fallos comunicados por sus compañeros? ¿Deberían movilizarse los técnicos siempre al instante?
¿Es algo nuevo? El mantenimiento ferroviario ha protagonizado un intenso debate a lo largo de la última semana. El propio exministro Óscar Puente apuntó las diferencias que hay entre el modelo alemán y el español: aquí las obras de mantenimiento y renovación del ferrocarril suelen ejecutarse en horario nocturno para alterar lo menos posible el tráfico diurno; en Alemania las líneas se cierran para acometer renovaciones de forma integral, sin importar si eso afecta al servicio durante largos períodos.
No se trata de decidir si el servicio ferroviario debe ofrecer mayor o menor seguridad, sino de hasta qué punto se está dispuesto a asumir interferencias en el tráfico.
¿Hay más factores? Sí. El debate sobre el mantenimiento y la gestión de la red de alta velocidad española ha cobrado importancia tras los accidentes de Adamuz y Urda, pero hay otra razón por la que debe ser prioritario: España es uno de los países con más kilómetros de alta velocidad del mundo. Solo nos supera China en extensión de vías. Eso se explica por el despliegue de la infraestructura desde los años 90, lo que ha permitido tejer una malla amplia que, sin embargo, obliga también a un mayor esfuerzo de conservación.
Esta misma semana El Mundo reveló otro documento estratégico de Adif con un aviso a navegantes: a finales de esta misma década el número de sucesos que pueden afectar al tráfico ferroviario y achacables a la infraestructura rondará probablemente los 8.800, un 20% más que el año pasado.

articles.title: Für GTA 6: Playstation 5 jetzt kaufen – oder lieber bis zum Black Friday warten?
articles.text:
Für GTA 6: Playstation 5 jetzt kaufen – oder lieber bis zum Black Friday warten?
Fast genau 13 Jahre nach dem Start der PC-Version von GTA 5 wird Rockstar am 19. November den Nachfolger GTA 6 veröffentlichen. Doch diesmal läuft beim Release einiges anders. So wird es zum Stichtag keine PC-Fassung geben. Stattdessen kommt das Open-World-Game zunächst für die Xbox und die Playstation 5 heraus. Gamer:innen könnte das vor Probleme stellen. Nicht jeder hat schließlich eine Konsole zu Hause. Für den begehrten Titel kann sich die Anschaffung natürlich lohnen.
Die Frage ist nur: Wann ist der beste Zeitpunkt? Denn rund eine Woche nach der Veröffentlichung des Spiels findet am 27. November der Black Friday statt – auch wenn einige Händler wieder vorab mit längeren Angebotszeiträumen werben dürften. Lohnt sich also das Warten auf einen guten Deal? Das wollten wir wissen und haben uns die Zahlen aus dem Vorjahr angeschaut und bei zwei Preisportalen nachgefragt. Weil die Playstation 5 hierzulande unter anderem laut einer Erhebung von Idealo deutlich gefragter ist, als die Xbox, haben wir uns dabei auf die Varianten der Sony-Konsole beschränkt.
Werden Konsolen zum Black Friday günstiger?
Sowohl Idealo als auch Guenstiger.de haben bereits eigene Auswertungen zur möglichen Ersparnis am Black Friday veröffentlicht. Für seine Erhebung hat Idealo 10.000 Produkte von Oktober bis Dezember 2025 beobachtet. Guenstiger.de hat sich auf 300 Produkte beschränkt und Black-Friday-Aktions- mit Durchschnittspreisen im Oktober 2025 verglichen.
Laut Guenstiger.de können Gaming-Fans durchaus von Black-Friday-Angeboten profitieren. So waren Konsolen im Angebotszeitraum im Schnitt rund zehn Prozent günstiger als noch im Oktober 2025. Dasselbe galt für die zugehörigen Videospiele. Idealo kommt auf andere Werte. Demzufolge seien Rabatte für Spielkonsolen mit im Schnitt vier Prozent eher gering ausgefallen. Umgerechnet betrug die durchschnittliche Ersparnis 21 Euro. Allerdings: Eine genaue Unterteilung nach Modell und Variante haben wir bei Vergleichsplattformen nicht vorgenommen. Um herauszufinden, was das für die PS5 bedeutet, muss man also genauer hinschauen.
Laut Idealo ist der durchschnittliche Preis der Playstation 5 in der Standard- und Digital-Edition und der PS5 Pro im November 2025 jeweils nur um wenige Euro gefallen. Die Standard-Edition ohne dünnes Gehäuse ist sogar um zehn Euro im Preis gestiegen. Deutlich günstiger waren die Konsolen demnach im Angebotszeitraum rund um Weihnachten im Dezember. Hatte die dünne Digital-Edition im November noch rund 405 Euro im Schnitt gekostet, sank der Preis im Dezember auf 349 Euro. Die Standard-Edition kostete im Dezember im Schnitt 490,50 Euro (Vormonat: 519,99 Euro), die dünnere Standard-Edition 438,90 Euro (statt 476,95 Euro) und die Pro 679 Euro (statt 711,99 Euro).
Guenstiger.de sah die Playstation 5 Slim auf Nachfrage im Oktober 2025 bei 490 Euro. Betrachtet wurde dabei der Durchschnitt der besten Preise pro Tag. Zum Black Friday sei die Konsole dann ab 429 Euro angeboten worden. Schade: Die Preisentwicklung aus dem Vorjahr bis heute lässt sich auf der Plattform nicht nachprüfen. Die Verlaufskurve reicht maximal sechs Monate zurück.
Warum es bei der Playstation 5 in diesem Jahr knifflig wird
Was sich aber schon jetzt vermuten lässt: Die Preise von 2025 werden die diversen Varianten der PS5 eher nicht wieder erreichen. Das liegt vor allem daran, dass Sony im April 2026 als Reaktion auf die Chipkrise die Preise für seine Konsolen weltweit erhöht hat. In Deutschland sind die Varianten seitdem im Sony-eigenen Shop jeweils 100 Euro teurer. Auch etablierte Elektronikhändler wie Mediamarkt und Saturn haben hier mittlerweile nachgezogen und bieten etwa die Digital-Edition genau wie der Hersteller selbst für rund 600 Euro an.
Idealo hat ebenfalls steigende Preise im Jahresvergleich erkannt. Im Vergleich zum Durchschnittspreis im Oktober sind die Preise für die Konsolen wie folgt angestiegen:
- Playstation 5 Standard-Edition: rund 240 Euro (oder 47 Prozent)
- Playstation 5 Slim Standard-Edition: rund 165 Euro (oder 34 Prozent)
- Playstation 5 Slim Digital-Edition: rund 180 Euro (oder 43 Prozent)
Abseits von der Preiserhöhung sorgt natürlich auch GTA 6 selbst für eine hohe Nachfrage nach der Konsole. Diese gibt Händlern keinen Anlass dazu, jetzt die Preise zu senken.
Einen noch größeren Ausreißer stellt die Playstation 5 Pro dar. Sie ist um rund 610 Euro im Preis gestiegen. Das ist ein Plus von 84 Prozent. Tatsächlich ist die Konsole vielerorts vergriffen und nur auf Online-Marktplätzen für horrende Preise jenseits der 1.000 Euro zu bekommen. Die Verkäufer erhoffen sich offenbar, dass Fans, die auf den Release von GTA 6 hinfiebern, diese Beträge schon zahlen werden, um das Spiel auf Sonys leistungsstärkster Konsole zu spielen. Mit Besserung bei der Versorgung ist offenbar erst 2027 zu rechnen. Das berichtet Playfront. Das deutsche Magazin hatte nach eigenen Angaben im September 2026 ein Memo des Herstellers an Händler vorliegen.
    „Eine verlässliche Empfehlung, ob sich der Kauf jetzt oder erst zum Black Friday mehr lohnt, ist daher schwierig.“
Und am Black Friday 2026? Da sind mögliche Angebote nicht komplett ausgeschlossen. Immerhin liegt der Termin ja nach dem Release von GTA 6. Doch Experten dämpfen die Erwartungen: „Dass es zum Black Friday tatsächlich günstigere Angebote geben wird, ist angesichts der Gesamtsituation aber eher unwahrscheinlich“, erklärt Florian Kriegel von Idealo. „Eine verlässliche Empfehlung, ob sich der Kauf jetzt oder erst zum Black Friday mehr lohnt, ist daher schwierig.“
Bei Guenstiger.de sieht man ebenfalls steigende Preise, rät Sparfüchsen aber, die eine Woche bis zum Angebotszeitraum noch abzuwarten. „Die aktuelle Preiskurve zeigt einen starken Anstieg, daher würde ich raten, bis Black Friday zu warten beziehungsweise in der Black Week wachsam zu sein“, erklärt Nicole Berg, Head of Communications bei der Preisplattform, per Mail. „Auf jeden Fall sollte man jetzt schon einen Preisalarm einstellen, da manche Händler ja schon sehr früh mit Aktionen starten.“
Playstation 5 nur für GTA 6? Dann sollte es diese sein
Selbst die Experten sind sich also nicht einig, was die beste Strategie beim Kauf der Playstation 5 ist. Wollt ihr die Konsole sicher zum Start von GTA 6 haben, um an Tag 1 loszuzocken, dann lohnt sich derzeit wohl vor allem ein Blick auf die dünne Digital-Edition. Die ist mit rund 600 Euro derzeit die günstigste Variante der PS5. Und ob mit oder ohne Box: GTA 6 gibt es ohnehin nur als Download ohne Disc. Eine Konsolenvariante mit Laufwerk braucht ihr also nicht. Sollte sich das einmal ändern, könnt ihr nachträglich das passende Blu-ray-Laufwerk dazukaufen.
Wer das Spiel nicht sofort spielen will, kann den kurzen Zeitraum bis zum Black Friday aber auch abwarten. Im besten Fall gibt es ein günstiges Angebot oder ein Bundle, das für euch infrage kommt. Die Finger solltet ihr dagegen von der Playstation 5 Pro lassen, solange die Konsole nicht vorrätig ist und deutlich mehr als den von Sony aufgerufenen Preis kostet.

articles.title: Free vient de déployer une nouvelle mise à jour de sécurité pour les Freebox, qu'il faut rapidement installer
articles.text:
L'opérateur Free a déployé, jeudi dans la matinée, une mise à jour du Freebox Server destinée aux Freebox Revolution, Pop, Delta et Ultra, avec un accent mis sur la sécurité.
Une nouvelle mise à jour des Freebox, version 4.13.3, est disponible depuis ce jeudi 5 novembre à 10 heures, et Free garde ses habitudes en matière de sécurité. Des correctifs sont apportés, sans plus de détails. Cette dernière mise à jour arrive tout juste deux semaine après la 4.13.2, au terme d'une rentrée qui a sérieusement remanié le Wi-Fi des box de l'opérateur. Pour en profiter, mieux vaut pousser manuellement l'installation.
Free enchaîne les mises à jour de sécurité sur ses Freebox
La version 4.13.3 du Freebox Server concerne les Freebox Revolution, Pop, Delta et Ultra. En évoquant des « correctifs de sécurité », le détail de la mise à jour de Free tient en quelques mots. L'opérateur ne nomme aucune faille, et c'est de bonne guerre, puisque détailler une vulnérabilité avant que tout le parc soit à jour reviendrait à donner une carte au trésor aux pirates. Sur l'application Free, l'opérateur évoque un « renforcement de la sécurité et de la protection du système ».
Cette version succède à la 4.13.2, sortie le jeudi 22 octobre dernier. Avant, la rentrée avait surtout profité au Wi-Fi. Le 16 septembre, la 4.13.0 rendait les canaux DFS utilisables même en présence de répéteurs. La bande 5 GHz pouvait passer de 80 à 160 MHz, ce qui double le débit théorique. Cinq jours plus tard, la 4.13.1 corrigeait un problème rare dans le choix de la liaison entre les répéteurs et le Server.
Mettre à jour sa Freebox, plusieurs façons d'appuyer sur le bon bouton
À tous les Freenautes distraits, sachez que votre box n'installera rien tant qu'elle n'aura pas redémarré, et c'est à vous de déclencher l'opération. Le plus rapide reste de passer par l'application Free, qui a absorbé Freebox Connect il y a quelques mois. Une fois ouverte, rendez-vous dans vos équipements Freebox, touchez « Serveur internet », puis « Version logicielle » et « Mettre à jour ».
Si vous le souhaitez, vous pouvez directement passer par la box, en utilisant les flèches du Server qui mènent au menu « Redémarrage ». Pour vérifier la version installée sur l'écran du boîtier, passez par « Informations avancées » puis « Version » sur Pop et Ultra, par « Version » sur Delta, ou par « Système » puis « Version » sur Revolution.

articles.title: Pasos para canjear los códigos de Free Fire este 5 de noviembre de 2026 y reclamar diamantes gratis
articles.text:
Garena habilitó una nueva tanda de códigos de Free Fire para este jueves 5 de noviembre de 2026, con opciones para reclamar diamantes, skins de armas, atuendos y otros objetos dentro del videojuego.
Las claves permiten acceder a recompensas sin costo, aunque su disponibilidad puede variar según el servidor, el territorio y el número de usos permitidos.
Como ocurre cada día, los jugadores deben ingresar los códigos cuanto antes en el portal oficial de recompensas de Garena. Las combinaciones deben copiarse sin modificaciones, con las mayúsculas correspondientes y sin espacios adicionales, porque un error mínimo puede impedir que el sistema valide la solicitud.
Qué códigos de Free Fire otorgan recompensas este 5 de noviembre de 2026
La lista para hoy reúne 14 combinaciones alfanuméricas. Cada una puede habilitar premios distintos, desde accesorios y cajas de contenido hasta diamantes gratis, trajes o aspectos para armas. No todos los códigos garantizan la misma recompensa y algunos pueden quedar restringidos por región.
- F7F9A3B2K6G8.
- UPQ7X5NMJ64V.
- FA3S7D5F1G9H.
- FFR4G3HM5YJN.
- FE2R8T6Y4U1.
- BR43FMAPYEZZ.
- FK3J9H5G1F7D.
- 6KWMFJVMQQYG.
- FU1I5O3P7A9S.
- FM6N1B8V3C4X.
- FZ5X1C7V9B2N.
- S9QK2L6VP3MR.
- FP9O1I5U3Y2T.
- FT4E9Y5U1I3O.
Cómo se deben canjear los códigos de Free Fire
El canje se realiza únicamente en el portal oficial de recompensas de Garena. Allí aparece el campo para pegar la combinación alfanumérica después de iniciar sesión con la cuenta vinculada al perfil de juego.
El usuario debe elegir el método de acceso que utiliza habitualmente en Free Fire, pegar uno de los códigos y revisar cada carácter antes de confirmar la operación. El sistema procesa el pedido y muestra un aviso sobre la validación de la clave o sobre el motivo por el cual no pudo aplicarse.
El portal admite perfiles asociados con Google, Facebook, Apple, Huawei o VK. La cuenta elegida debe ser la misma que está vinculada al progreso del jugador dentro de Free Fire, porque los premios se asignan a ese identificador.
Las cuentas de invitado no pueden utilizar el sistema de canje, incluso si el usuario tiene un código disponible y el juego instalado en su dispositivo. Antes de ingresar una clave, el jugador debe vincular su perfil con alguno de los proveedores autorizados para que el contenido quede asociado a la cuenta correcta.
Por qué no es posible canjear un código en Free Fire
El mensaje de “código inválido o expirado” puede aparecer cuando la combinación alcanzó su límite de usos, concluyó su período de validez o no está habilitada para el servidor desde el cual se realiza el intento. Garena puede aplicar condiciones diferentes según cada territorio y cada campaña de recompensas.
Asimismo, puede ser un error al copiar la secuencia. Los códigos mezclan letras y números, así que una mayúscula incorrecta, una cifra omitida o un carácter adicional impiden que el portal complete la solicitud. La pauta es pegar la combinación de forma directa y verificar que no haya espacios al principio ni al final.
Los jugadores pueden intentar usar más de una clave, siempre que cada una siga disponible. Si una combinación no funciona, no necesariamente implica que las otras hayan vencido, porque cada código puede tener reglas distintas de activación y distribución.
En qué momento llegan los diamantes y otros objetos a la cuenta
Las recompensas obtenidas suelen aparecer en el buzón interno de Free Fire en un plazo inferior a 24 horas. Por ese motivo, el contenido no siempre se incorpora de inmediato al inventario principal después de que el portal confirme la operación.
Tras completar el canje, conviene ingresar al juego y revisar la sección de mensajes o correo interno. Allí pueden aparecer cajas de contenido, accesorios, atuendos, skins de armas y otros elementos que requieren una confirmación adicional antes de quedar disponibles en el inventario.
Los diamantes están entre los incentivos más buscados porque permiten realizar compras y acceder a contenido de pago dentro del videojuego. Aun así, la recompensa final depende del código validado y de la disponibilidad que mantenga el sistema al momento del canje.

articles.title: Statehouse wins give Democrats new power to push clean energy
articles.text:
Before Tuesday’s election, Republicans held more governorships and state legislative seats than Democrats, along with an advantage in state trifectas—unified control of the governor’s office and both chambers of the legislature.
That advantage has disappeared, clearing the path for more climate and clean energy legislation, according to analysts and advocates.
Democrats swept the vast majority of competitive races at the state level, flipping control of governors’ offices from Republicans in Georgia, Iowa, Ohio, Nevada, and Texas.
Democrats have a 29-19 edge in governorships, with Kansas too close to call and Alaska likely to take a while to declare a winner.
The party is on track for a net gain of hundreds of legislative seats, potentially giving it control of more nationwide than Republicans for the first time in more than a decade. Going into the election, Republicans had 4,072 seats and Democrats held 3,257, according to MultiState, a research and lobbying firm. Democrats had a net gain of more than 350 seats on Tuesday and are likely to add several hundred more as results continue to be tabulated, according to MultiState.
Democrats won five new trifectas: Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin, with Arizona likely to be the sixth once officials finish counting. Those additions would give the party 22 trifectas, with Republicans holding unified control in 18 states and nine with split control. Kansas is yet to be determined.
Republicans lost trifectas in Iowa, Georgia, Texas, New Hampshire, and Ohio. Before the election, Republicans had trifectas in 23 states, Democrats had 16, and 11 were under split control.
The implications for climate and energy policy are likely to be profound, said Caroline Spears, executive director of Climate Cabinet, an advocacy group.
“In the states, we had a generational political window shift to make people’s lives better, to lower costs, and to lower climate pollution at the same time,” she said in a conference call.

articles.title: Daksham Growth Ventures Fund raises Rs 125 Cr as first close
articles.text:
Daksham Capital raises Rs 125 Cr in first close of Rs 300 Cr fund
The fund will invest in startups at the pre-Series A and Series A stages, with cheque sizes ranging from Rs 5 crore to Rs 20 crore. It will focus on D2C brands, consumer enablers, B2B2C businesses, supply chains and consumer AI.
Daksham Capital, a multi-family office and private wealth management group, has raised Rs 125 crore as the first close of its Daksham Growth Ventures (DGV) Fund I.
According to a statement, DGV Fund I has a target corpus of Rs 300 crore, comprising a base corpus of Rs 150 crore and a greenshoe option of another Rs 150 crore. The first close was anchored by family offices, HNI/UHNI families and entrepreneurs.
The fund will invest in startups at the pre-Series A and Series A stages, with cheque sizes ranging from Rs 5 crore to Rs 20 crore. It will focus on D2C brands, consumer enablers, B2B2C businesses, supply chains and consumer AI.
According to the statement, the fund's preferred entry range is businesses with annual recurring revenue (ARR) of Rs 25–75 crore, with a focus on companies that have the potential to scale to Rs 300–500 crore in revenue.
“Over the last decade, we have backed consumer start-ups that went on to deliver strong outcomes. What is changing now is how consumers discover, choose and buy. We believe the next decade of consumption will be shaped by brands and start-ups working alongside AI – from discovery and personalisation to fulfilment, trust and credit,” said Shivam Diwan, Co-Founder & Managing Partner, Daksham Growth Ventures.
Beyond capital, DGV will also work closely with portfolio companies on governance, financial reporting, brand positioning, leadership development and distribution expansion.
“We see considerable potential in businesses that understand their consumers, have built a strong foundation and are ready to expand their ambitions. Our focus is to build long-term partnerships that align capital with the opportunities ahead,” said Saket Lakhotia, Co-Founder & Group CEO, Daksham Capital.
Daksham Capital is a wealth and asset management group that acts as family office advisor and investment banker to HNI and UHNI families, business houses, CXOs, promoters of listed companies and family trusts.

articles.title: 14 millions de plaques d’immatriculation piratées en France : Auto-Planning confirme une cyberattaque massive
articles.text:
Le site spécialisé FrenchBreaches révèle que des pirates ont mis en vente une énorme base de données dérobée à Auto-Planning. Cette entreprise française permet aux centres de contrôle technique de gérer leurs rendez-vous en ligne et d’envoyer des rappels par SMS à leurs clients. Une plateforme concurrente, baptisée Auto Contrôle Paris, est également touchée par les mêmes cybercriminels.
Plus de 200 millions de lignes de données
Les hackers, qui se font appeler « Operation GlassLodge » sur les forums criminels, affirment avoir dérobé plus de 200 millions de lignes de données. Selon les estimations de FrenchBreaches, le fichier concerne près de 18 millions de personnes et 13,9 millions de plaques d’immatriculation. Certaines données ne sont pas récentes et remonteraient à 2008.
Les échantillons contiennent les noms et prénoms des automobilistes, leurs adresses e-mail et numéros de téléphone, leurs plaques, la marque et le modèle de leurs véhicules, ou encore la date et l’heure de leurs rendez-vous. Près de 92 millions de rendez-vous sont recensés dans les répertoires, assurent les pirates. Ils affirment aussi détenir 36 545 factures au format PDF. Ces documents sensibles pourraient contenir des relevés d’identité bancaire (RIB), ce qui ouvre la voie à des arnaques ou à des tentatives d’usurpation d’identité. Les cybercriminels ont réclamé 33 333 dollars de rançon à Auto-Planning, menaçant de divulguer toutes les données sur la toile. Rien n’indique que l’entreprise a répondu à la demande du gang.
L’entreprise a vite reconnu l’attaque. C’est également le cas d’Auto Contrôle Paris. Conformément à leurs obligations légales, Auto-Planning et Auto Contrôle Paris ont prévenu la CNIL (Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés), le gendarme des données personnelles en France.
À lire aussi : Des frigos à plus de 100°C – après les supermarchés, des pirates s’attaquent aux congélateurs du don du sang
Fausses amendes et faux contrôles techniques
Une plaque d’immatriculation, croisée avec un nom, un numéro de téléphone et une date de rendez-vous, représente une sérieuse menace pour tous les Français concernés. Avec ces informations, un escroc peut envoyer un SMS d’arnaque très crédible. Il peut vous demander de confirmer votre prochain contrôle technique en payant des « frais de réservation » fictifs, ou de régler une fausse amende de l’ANTAI en citant votre véritable plaque.
Une plaque associée à une identité peut aussi aboutir à une usurpation d’identité. La victime risque alors de recevoir des contraventions pour des infractions qu’elle n’a pas commises. Le croisement d’une adresse et d’un modèle de véhicule pourrait aussi aider des malfaiteurs à repérer une voiture en particulier, un modèle de luxe par exemple, ou un domicile laissé vide.
Ce n’est pas la première fois que des plaques d’immatriculation se retrouvent entre les mains de cybercriminels. Fin octobre, un pirate surnommé ChimeraZ affirmait déjà avoir volé une base de près de 850 000 plaques françaises, associées au nom, au téléphone et à l’adresse de leurs propriétaires.
